reason_codes.meaning: No accepted source change occurred after the frozen cutoff, so the original baseline may continue.
The affected baseline will be abandoned and re-frozen at a later cutoff.
The original cutoff will be completed before a separate ordinary update processes the later observation.
The original frozen package was not preserved after a later source change.
The post-cutoff source change was not preserved as a separate Observation.
Artifacts from different cutoffs may not be silently mixed into one baseline.
The original cutoff may not claim later currency before the separate update passes.
